_comment: Regional (masked) IPAdapter for exactly TWO characters in one scene.
Built to fix real, live-observed 'characters mixing/bleeding into each
other' - the single-reference workflow forces IPAdapter to condition the
WHOLE frame on ONE character's portrait, which visibly bled that
character's face/features onto whoever else was in the scene. This
workflow instead applies IPAdapter TWICE, sequentially, each instance
masked to only affect its own half of the frame (attn_mask on
IPAdapterAdvanced - confirmed present on that node's schema, no new
custom node pack needed beyond what character-consistent-story-
ipadapter-sdxl.json already requires).
Character ordering: caller decides which reference is LEFT vs RIGHT -
see ProductionPipelineService's resolveDualReferenceImages. Simple
first-character-in-scene = left heuristic for now, not derived from
SceneVisualSpec's per-character 'position' field yet (real improvement,
not done here - would need parsing 'left'/'right'/'center' text reliably).
Only handles exactly 2 characters, left/right split down the middle -
does not generalize to 3+ (would need N-way region logic, a bigger
build). 3+ character scenes still fall back to no reference at all, per
the existing multi-character guard in ProductionPipelineService.
UNVERIFIED like every workflow file in this project - never run against
live ComfyUI while building it. Test one 2-character scene before
trusting this for a real episode; if MaskComposite's operation='add'
doesn't behave as expected on your installed version, try 'set' instead.
Requires the same files as character-consistent-story-ipadapter-sdxl.json:
clip_vision_h.safetensors, ip-adapter-plus_sdxl_vit-h.bin
